pinned_settings.rdf_storage_mode: space-optimized (tool default since 2026-09-10; pinned explicitly by every script here)
pinned_settings.hdt_strategy: partitioned (pinned explicitly; never 'auto' in a recorded run)

notes: One experiment at a time. Two concurrent runs invalidate memory and timing.

Local-build mode tags the image with the commit that built it. A dirty tree yields a '-dirty' tag that does not identify one source state; commit before a publishable run. Set BM_IMAGE_VERSION to reproduce against a published release instead.
10_feasibility.sh is the only script that deliberately imposes a memory ceiling.
